## Change and scope

Describe the behavior or document change. Link the applicable decision and approval if this changes requirements, architecture, or contracts. For an editorial update to an approved reference, explain why its meaning is unchanged.

## Documentation impact

List the current documents, progress or checklist entries updated, or explain why no update is needed. Describe permission, privacy or compatibility changes when applicable.

## Verification

Record the commands or browser cases actually run and their results. Identify the tested revision or snapshot and any pending checks.
